note: Each case mutates one field of the valid catalog, so a negative cannot pass by drifting away from the real surface.

cases.why: memory:write is not in the closed scope vocabulary; only proposals may be written
tool names are verb_noun with underscores; a hyphen breaks the harness tool id mcp__im2a__<name>
a description shorter than 40 chars cannot say when to use the tool
error codes are a closed set; free text would make agent recovery unprogrammable
inputSchema must describe an object; a scalar schema means the caller cannot send named arguments
sideEffect classes drive approval routing; an invented class would bypass it
unknown root keys must fail loudly instead of being ignored by a lenient reader

set.prompt: system prompt smuggled into the catalog

cases.why: without profileVersion a reader cannot tell which profile to parse
a tool without declared errors cannot be recovered from
the bridge must not drift from the pinned MCP version
a caller-dependent tool list cannot be publicly cacheable
a tool without a scope is an unauthenticated capability
one error-code convention only: UPPER_SNAKE, matching the skill runtime; a second casing means two vocabularies
the unprefixed name form is exactly 'curator'; any other prefix-less name must fail

validMutations.why: the curator mount point is the one unprefixed tool name; its scope comes from the semantic map in the checker, not from the pattern
